title: Corn Planting Moon Milk Moon Vesak Festival Moon poetry of perigee keeping time as souls spin in splintered light At Buddha's birthday Glooskap picks
summary: Corn Planting Moon Milk Moon Vesak Festival Moon poetry of perigee keeping time as souls spin in splintered light At Buddha's birthday Glooskap picks flowers on Algonquin shores mine, yours, theirs, our #FlowerMoon #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Corn Planting Moon
Milk Moon
Vesak Festival Moon
poetry of perigee
keeping time as souls
spin in splintered light
At Buddha's birthday
Glooskap picks
flowers on Algonquin shores
mine, yours,
theirs, our
#FlowerMoon
#smallpoems
